name: Optimize / Defrag Drives
description: Runs Windows drive optimization for all fixed drives, defragmenting HDDs and optimizing SSDs via retrim where supported.

description_i18n.en: Runs Windows drive optimization for all fixed drives, defragmenting HDDs and optimizing SSDs via retrim where supported.
description_i18n.de: Führt die Optimierung aller Festplatten durch: HDDs werden entfragmentiert und SSDs optimiert (ReTrim), falls unterstützt.
description_i18n.fr: Exécute l'optimisation des disques pour tous les lecteurs fixes, défragmantant les HDD et optimisant les SSD via ReTrim si pris en charge.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes defrag.exe with the /O flag on all fixed volumes to perform optimization The script checks for before applying changes and reports success or failure per drive
compact_description: Optimizes all fixed drives with Windows recommended optimization.
